Summary: The HotpotQA original paper by Yang et al. (2018) mentions that BM25 retrieval was used in their experiments, achieving an improvement of 10.59 F1 points on the hidden test set. The paper also notes that the accuracy of a BM25 retriever for finding all supporting evidence for a question decreases from 53.7% to 25.9% on the 'easy' and 'hard' subsets of the HOTPOTQA training dataset. The sources do not provide specific details about the Hits@10 metric for the BM25 retrieval model on the HotpotQA test set.
